headline: Sri Lanka taxman to issue valuation rules for crypto and gems under expanded capital gains tax
summary: The 2027 budget proposes adding digital and virtual assets, including cryptocurrencies, alongside telecom and broadcasting assets under an expanded capital gains tax. The tax authority will issue valuation rules.
why: Capital gains tax rules determine how investors are taxed on asset disposals, and valuation rules set how gains are measured. Clear rules matter for crypto holders and asset managers.
